beats.ul-3-001: You stand before the towering bronze doors of the Cataloguers' Court, where a stern clerk demands your travel permit and searches your belongings for illicit manuscripts.
beats.ul-3-017: Armed beadles intercept your progress down the vaulted corridor, escorting you into a dim antechamber filled with the ticking of a hundred water-clocks.
beats.ul-3-042: A massive iron portcullis slams shut ahead of you, operated by a mechanical registrar who demands a heavy toll of rare marginalia.
beats.ul-3-063: You navigate a labyrinthine filing labyrinth where towering shelves slide back and forth to crush unauthorized intruders.
beats.ul-3-084: A detachment of red-robed enforcers blocks the archway, demanding you surrender all notes pertaining to the missing Archivist.
beats.ul-3-109: You emerge into a vast subterranean rotunda where towering pillars of index cards support a vaulted ceiling of dark stone.
beats.ul-3-126: A narrow bridge constructed entirely from the reinforced spines of giant encyclopedias spans a deep ink-river below.
beats.ul-3-141: You descend a spiral staircase carved from fossilised paper, where the walls murmur ancient rules of classification.
beats.ul-3-165: You enter the grand tribunal chamber where the Grand Cataloguer presides over a glowing map of the entire Underlibrary.
beats.ul-3-179: A wall of living parchment blocks the exit, requiring a blood-seal or a classified password to grant further access.
beats.ul-3-195: You step out onto the Grand Balcony overlooking the vast, hazy expanse of the Deep Annexe where the Hundredth Door waits.
beats.ul-3-215: You cross the final threshold past the broken seal, stepping into the absolute silence of the Deep Annexe where the original Index rests.

ul-3-002.situation: Rows of high desks stretch into the gloom where junior scribes sort whispering index cards by obsolete filing systems.

ul-3-018.situation: Spectators in grey robes watch from tiered benches as judges deliberate over charges of unauthorized cataloguing.

ul-3-043.situation: Despairing scholars plead their cases at individual booths while ink-stained scribes record every whispered grievance.

ul-3-064.situation: Rows of heavy oak bookcases glide across recessed tracks, rearranging the geography of the entire chamber.

ul-3-085.situation: Armor clinks against wooden bunks in a long, smoke-filled dormitory smelling of linseed oil and polished brass.

ul-3-110.situation: Millions of catalogued index cards flutter like trapped moths in the drafts stirred by unseen subterranean vents.

ul-3-127.situation: Heavy leather-bound volumes form a precarious crossing over dark, slow-moving channels of black printing ink.

ul-3-142.situation: Narrow steps wind endlessly downward between sheer walls of compressed, indestructible pulp and yellowed vellum.

ul-3-166.situation: High stained-glass windows depict legendary librarians sorting the stars while golden scales hang motionless above the judges.

ul-3-180.situation: A massive stretched hide writhes gently against the corridor walls, bearing pulsing veins of black printer's ink.

ul-3-196.situation: Stone balustrades overlook a dizzying abyss filled with drifting book-stacks, floating lanterns, and distant whispering echoes.
